mechanism: Revised per-page font-family lifetime: ordinary secondary-page titles use the same complete bundled CJK font. Unfixed registers a unique font family for each page instance; fixed reuses one family. Normal city-manager visits retain duplicate font resources in the unfixed process. Original same-family MainPage recreation and parsing premises remain unverified and archived; no weather network or CPU claim.
fix_summary: Share one immutable page-title font family across secondary-page instances instead of allocating a new family on every visit.

performance_oracle.definition: Final absolute whole-process kernel PSS after one warmup and forty normal city-manager page visits. Every pair must meet 2.0x and 64 MiB excess. No CPU or original same-family reparse claim.
performance_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 2.0 * fixed and unfixed - fixed >= 64 MiB in each of 3 paired rounds
performance_oracle.workload_notes: Explicit business revision to per-page CJK title font-family lifetime. Measure final absolute kernel PSS after forty ordinary city-manager visits. All three pairs must reach 2.0x and 64 MiB excess, with identical city content and title pixels.
